message: Last week, we had an unexpected blackout, and while I dug out the flashlights and power banks, our family group chat lit up with messages. My sister sent a funny meme about being trapped in the dark ages, while my kids shared their plans for a ‘campout’ in the living room. It's amazing how a little humor can keep the spirits high during a power outage! How do you keep it light when the lights go out?
